claim: The Production front for どの is one word away from the front for どれ, which I learned in Lesson 5, so I will answer どれ.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Grammar & Function Words / Which (of three or more things)'. Earlier card chapter-5 どれ | 'Which one (of three or more things)'. The difference (どの goes before a noun) is only in this card's note: 'どの (dono) is used instead when which is followed by a noun, e.g. どの バス'.
fix: Add a hint such as 'before a noun, as in which bus' to the front.

claim: The hint glosses に as 'in/on/at', but the に card in this same lesson teaches it as 'To' (direction) and no card has taught an in/on/at meaning.
evidence: Recognition BACK and Production FRONT hint: 'the alternative to に (ni, "in/on/at")'. chapter-6/ni-particle answer: 'To (particle, indicates direction of movement)'.
fix: Change the hint to 'the alternative to に (ni, "to")' or just 'the alternative to に (ni)'.

claim: The English 'Please come in.' does not match the note, which says the こちら here means 'this way', so from the English alone I would not build こちらへ.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Please come in. / said by a host or staff member showing you where to go'. Note: 'The こちら (kochira) here is directional, this way'. Earlier: chapter-0 どうぞ | 'Please.'
fix: Use 'This way, please.' as the English (or 'This way, please. / Please come in.').

claim: The note says this book has taught こちら only as 'this is …' for a person, not as a place, but the very next card in this lesson teaches こちら as 'this way'.
evidence: Note: 'Careful with こちら (kochira): so far this book teaches it only as this is … for introducing a person (Lesson 1), not as a place.' chapter-6/douzo-kochira-e note: 'The こちら (kochira) here is directional, this way'.
fix: Rewrite the note to say こちら is also 'this way / here (where I am)', as in どうぞこちらへ.

claim: Nothing on the front asks for へ, so I answer with に (the deck calls it 'the usual choice'), and this card never makes me produce へ.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Travel & Tourism / Smith-san is going to the party.' Answer: 'スミスさんはパーティーへいきます'. Note: 'The same sentence works with に (ni) in place of へ (e).' Compare chapter-6-extras/he-eki-e-ikimasu, whose front adds 'the direction particle written へ but read "e"'.
fix: Add the same hint he-eki-e-ikimasu uses, naming the へ particle.

claim: This base card uses きのう, which has no card in the base unit; its own card is only in the extras unit, so on first meeting I have to infer it from the English.
evidence: Recognition FRONT: 'スミスさんはきのうともだちとレストランにいきました'. No ledger card and no base card teaches きのう; chapter-6-extras/yesterday is the first きのう card.
fix: Ship the きのう card in the base unit (it is listed as excluded there) or swap the time word for one the base unit cards.

claim: The deck's only example sentence for たち uses ともだちたち, which repeats the 'dachi' sound already in ともだち and reads doubtful; the base unit has a plainer example to hand in ひとたち.
evidence: Target: 'ともだちたちとこうえんにいきます' | 'I'm going to the park with (my) friends.' The tachi-suffix note gives the same word: 'e.g. ともだちたち (tomodachitachi, friends)'. chapter-6-extras/hitori-de-kouen-ni-ikimashita quotes it again.
fix: Check ともだちたち with a native speaker; if it is marginal, use ともだちと (no たち) or a plainer たち word such as がくせいたち in the example and the note.

claim: 'Which one is Smith-san's bag?' is exactly the shape Lesson 5 taught as Xはどれですか, so I will answer スミスさんのかばんはどれですか, not the どれが form this card wants.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Other / Which one is Smith-san's bag?' Answer: 'どれがスミスさんのかばんですか'. Earlier: chapter-5 あかいシャツはどれですか | 'Which one is the red shirt?'. The card's own note admits the Lesson 5 order is correct.
fix: Add a hint such as 'putting どれ first' to the Production front.

claim: Without the phone context, 'This is Smith, of the Tokyo branch.' reads like introducing someone else, which this deck taught as こちらは…のXさんです.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Work & Occupations / This is Smith, of the Tokyo branch.' (no hint). Earlier: chapter-1 こちらはロンドンぎんこうのブラウンさんです | 'This is Brown-san of the Bank of London.'; chapter-1-extras ABCフーズのスミスです | 'I am Smith of ABC Foods.' The phone context is only in the note: 'Naming yourself on the phone'.
fix: Add a hint such as 'naming yourself when you answer the phone'.

claim: 'This one is Smith-san's.' is nearly the same English as a Lesson 2 card that answers これはスミスさんのです, so I may give は; the hint helps but does not say which particle.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Other / This one is Smith-san's. / answering which of several bags belongs to Smith-san'. Answer: 'これがスミスさんのです'. Earlier: chapter-2-extras これはスミスさんのです | 'This is Smith-san's.'
fix: Extend the hint to make the が explicit, e.g. 'answering どれが…ですか: which of several bags is Smith-san's'.

claim: 'Well then, see you tomorrow.' fits じゃ、あした just as well, since the deck taught じゃ as 'Well then' first; the base では card has a 'more formal' hint and this one has none.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Greetings / Well then, see you tomorrow.' Answer: 'では、あした'. Earlier: chapter-4 じゃ | 'Well then'; chapter-0 じゃ、また | 'See you.'; chapter-6/dewa front adds 'the fuller, more formal form'.
fix: Add a hint such as 'the more formal well then'.

claim: In this deck 'X, please.' has meant ください and 'I would like X, please.' has meant おねがいします, so 'Coffee and tea, please.' leads me to ください.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Food / Coffee and tea, please.' Answer: 'コーヒーとこうちゃをおねがいします'. Earlier: chapter-4-extras コーヒーをください | 'Coffee, please.'; コーヒーをおねがいします | 'I would like a coffee, please.'; chapter-4 カレーとサラダをおねがいします | 'I would like curry and salad, please.'
fix: Use 'I would like coffee and tea, please.' to match the deck's おねがいします wording.

claim: Nothing on the front asks for へ, so I answer with に and never practise the particle this card is built on.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Shopping / I went to the department store in Ginza yesterday.' Answer: 'きのうぎんざのデパートへいきました'. he-eki-e-ikimasu carries a へ hint; this card does not.
fix: Add the へ hint he-eki-e-ikimasu uses.

claim: Nothing on the front asks for へ, so I answer with に and never practise the particle this card is built on.
evidence: Production FRONT: 'Travel & Tourism / Are you going to the park tomorrow?' Answer: 'あしたこうえんへいきますか'. he-eki-e-ikimasu carries a へ hint; this card does not.

claim: The note talks about 'her' and 'his' reply in a dialogue I never see, so on a shuffled card the 'her' and 'him' mean nothing.
evidence: Note: 'Asked by the person at the destination, so the verb is きます (kimasu), the movement is toward her. The reply flips to いきます (ikimasu), because the speaker there chooses from his own position.'
fix: Say it without the dialogue: 'Asked by someone at the destination, so きます; the traveller answers with いきます.'
